sessionDescription: One hour of CW — name and CWops number
historyFileDescription: N1MM CWOPS exchanges, cached for offline use. Configure the source in CWT Prefill settings.
historyEmpty: No valid file cached yet. Download the CWT file in Settings → Accounts, Services & Data Sources (Data Files in earlier builds).
historyUnsupportedSavedSource: The saved source is unsupported. Automatic discovery is being used until you enter a supported HTTPS N1MM URL.
historyInvalidSource: Use an HTTPS N1MM URL or leave blank for automatic discovery. Local file paths are not supported.
historyHelp:
The default N1MM category discovers its latest CWOPS download. You may select an HTTPS CWOPS entry or direct text URL on the N1MM hosts. After changing the source, refresh the CWT data file. The previous valid file remains active until a replacement succeeds.

Operator edits and deliberate blanks take priority. Next: current-operation CWT exchanges, this selected file, then older CWT exchanges. If no exchange is found, Number/QTH prefills from the station's state or country prefix. Verify it against the received exchange; a location guess does not establish nonmembership.

Log CWT contacts one callsign at a time; multi-call entry shares exchange controls.

Based on the official CWT extension by **Sebastian Delmont, KI2D**, the main Ham2K developer. Disable the original CWops CWT extension to avoid duplicate handlers.
spotsHelp: The RBN extension can use this file to filter spots. Choose the call-history filter in RBN settings. File membership does not prove current CWT participation.
